purpose: Pin each insight's numeric id to its question so a URL never moves. The id was previously the array position, so inserting or removing one question upstream renumbered every question after it - the old URL then 404d or resolved to a different question. Seeded from the published slugs on 2026-08-25, so existing URLs are preserved exactly.
note: A title can legitimately repeat under one prefix (6 cases at seed time). Positional numbering separated those by accident; the list preserves that separation deliberately.
